title: Cloud-created score is missing from the hosted Mine results
description:
A score created through the authenticated production CLI is retrievable through AppSync, but does not appear on https://apricity.anth.us/scores with mine=1.

Expected: a signed-in owner sees a newly created cloud score in the hosted Scores list.

Observed: scr_scores_mushroom-jazz-drift_apr exists in production and is owned by google_101686548942916378620, which the web client recognizes as one of the signed-in user’s owner identities, but the hosted view omits it.

Investigate the web list query, filters, and display conversion; add a regression test and fix the incompatible CLI payload or web filtering behavior.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verified the production record, handle, owner filter, and hidden-score list. The web session had loaded its in-memory score list before the external CLI mutation. A full reload of https://apricity.anth.us/scores/?q=mushroom&order=recent&mine=1 now shows 1 score, mushroom-jazz-drift, by @techjunkie. No schema, authorization, or payload defect reproduced; the hosted UI currently does not receive an external CLI mutation invalidation event.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Resolved as a stale pre-publish browser cache: the production score appears after reload under the requested Mine filter.
